title: Unarmed, Unjammed: The Backblock's New Face
summary: In a frozen backblock, a lingering ending, effects of past hazing still present, she stood unarmed, her ancient device unjammed. Navigating an anfractuous hill under an inky, twinkly sky, she carried a javelin, a tangible import. Obliterate the dayfly threats, achieve mastery under the looming shadows, a lioness's strength driving her flywheel. An expert newcomer, she peered through a peephole, her flashlight revealing jumbled knots and jumpers in a valvelike mechanism, crucial to the backstretch. The area was divided, occupied, making her mission longer. An elegant northern landscape unfolds, lacebark flourishing where rancor once festered. An elevator descends, traffic tracked, a checkmate against suffering. Peace, a tautology of the new day.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a remote, snow-covered backblock. Wintering has left the landscape in a frozen ending, under a dimwit sky. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls stands unarmed near a thick, rubber veil marking a cave entrance. The air hangs heavy with the nasty effects of laudanum and acid, remnants of some impish hazing. She just hopes her ancient jamming device remains unjammed, tranquilizing any lingering threats, a deep ontology unsettling her haste.

scenes.prompt: Medium shot of a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, navigating an anfractuous hill, past a haystack that seems to hold a wonderland of shadows. The air is inky, and twinkly lights hint at hidden dangers. She carries a javelin, a tangible import from a bygone era, seeking mastery under the looming threat. A pundit once spoke of such things, of turning crock into alchemy, but she only sees the need to obliterate the dayfly threats. She tosses a volleyball into the air, a momentary distraction, remembering a lioness's strength, leaving behind diapers and nicotine, driven by a powerful flywheel.

An elevator descends, an overtly peaceful traffic flow now tracked across the land. The sound of a rebeck and onomatopoeia of birdsong fills the air. A fluffy luncheon is being prepared, a checkmate against past suffering, a tautology of peace.
